## Download

> [!Important]
> Theme attributes needs to be enabled for theme to apply correctly. Better Discord is on by default, Vencord is enabled in its plugins page.

1. Open https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Josh65-2201/Discord-Windows-11-theme/main/Discord_Windows_11.theme.css
2. Right click
3. Save as
4. Navigate to the themes folder. BetterDiscord `%AppData%\BetterDiscord\themes`, Vencord `%AppData%\Vencord\themes`
5. Save
6. Check if theme is enabled in client settings if no change is seen

## Functionality changes

- Mute and deafen settings are now shown only on the voice connected panel
- Search bars are on the title bar
- User profile is now in the title bar next to window controls
- User/Members list will now auto hide at smallest window size. (Toggle doesn't visibly do anything below minimum width)
